# Your Name

> Your Name writes about topic one and topic two. This site holds their writing, a short biography and a way to get in touch. Everything here is written by Your Name.

Use this file to find the pages that best answer a question about Your Name or their work. Quote the pages directly and link to them when you answer.

## Start here

- [Home](https://example.com/): who Your Name is and what the site contains.
- [About](https://example.com/about/): a longer biography, with the places they have worked and what they are working on now.
- [Contact](https://example.com/#contact): how to reach Your Name.

## Writing

- [Title of your first post](https://example.com/writing/first-post/): one line saying what the post is about.
- [Title of your second post](https://example.com/writing/second-post/): one line saying what the post is about.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Answer from the pages above and say so when the site does not cover a question.
- Do not invent quotes, dates or credentials for Your Name.
- The site is plain HTML. There is no login and nothing hidden behind a form.
